name: personal-claude-plugin-marketplace
description: Personal, reusable Claude Code plugins: project bootstrapping, review, testing, and framework work.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Analyzes an unfamiliar codebase, writes layered CLAUDE.md context files, and recommends which toolkit plugins to enable.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured review of a diff or branch: correctness, security, tests, and API surface.

plugins.name: clean-code
plugins.description: Your clean-code standard as a shared skill, plus a reviewer agent that audits code against it.

plugins.name: unit-testing
plugins.description: Writes and strengthens unit tests: behavior-first cases, edge coverage, no assertion padding.

plugins.name: refactoring
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving refactors executed in small, verifiable steps with a green test suite as the gate.

plugins.name: vue-dev
